title: Engineer / Technical Officer - Road Design (East)
content_text:
Engineer / Technical Officer - Road Design (East) | Careers Vic
Employer: Department of Transport and Planning
Work Type: Ongoing - Full-time
Salary:
$81,496 - $98,955
Grade: VPS 3
Occupation: Engineering
Location: Melbourne - Eastern suburbs
Reference: 12067
About Us
We create thriving places and connected communities. We plan, build and maintain Victoria’s transport, planning and land services. We are committed to a safe, inclusive and high-performing workplace.
We welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds and are committed to creating a safe, inclusive workplace where our people can thrive and do meaningful work.
About the role
The Engineer / Technical Officer Road Design supports the design, documentation and delivery of road and traffic engineering projects across Victoria. Working under supervision, the role contributes to projects from concept through to detailed design, including road layouts, intersections, drainage, safety barriers, signage, line marking and 3D modelling.
The role uses MicroStation and OpenRoads to develop designs, drawings and project documentation within agreed timeframes and budgets. It applies road design and traffic engineering standards and supports Safe Systems principles to improve road safety. The role also builds effective stakeholder relationships and prepares reports, briefs and technical advice.
What we’re looking for (Selection Criteria)
You’re someone who:
You’re someone who works collaboratively, sharing information, supporting colleagues and contributing positively to achieving team goals.
You’re someone who delivers work effectively, prioritising tasks according to urgency and impact, working to agreed plans and maintaining accurate project records.
You’re someone who applies sound judgement and problem-solving skills, using established policies and processes to resolve issues and seeking guidance when needed.
You’re someone who applies foundational engineering knowledge professionally, using relevant standards, guidelines, codes and risk controls to develop and document practical engineering solutions.
You’re someone who is adaptable and technically capable, open to new approaches and developing skills in road and traffic engineering, roadside safety, and CAD tools including MicroStation and OpenRoads.
Position Description: linked from the advert (Dropbox PDF, "DTP Position Description Engineer Technical Officer Road Design VPS3 August 2026"); read on 29 Sep 2026; see extra/dtp_position_description.txt. Mandatory: relevant tertiary qualification in Civil Engineering. Desirable: knowledge of road design, roadside infrastructure and drainage to Austroads Guide to Road Design and DTP supplements; experience with Bentley MicroStation Connect, OpenRoads Designer and ProjectWise.
Qualifications and experience
You’ll bring:
Victorian Driver’s License
Construction Induction Card (White Card)
Ability to travel within the state for site inspections
Pre-employment checks and employment conditions
Relevant pre-employment screening and reference checks will be required.
Applicants must be an Australian Citizen, Permanent Resident or hold a valid work permit or visa necessary for the nature of the position.
Recipients of Victorian Public Service (VPS) voluntary departure packages should note that re-employment restrictions apply.
How to apply
Click the ‘Apply’ button to be redirected to our recruitment platform, where you may need to create an account to submit your application.
Applications close at 11.59pm on Tuesday, 6 October 2026.
Please include both your resume and a cover letter addressing how your experience addresses each of the key selection criteria for the role. All applications must be submitted via the online portal, we’re unable to accept email or manual submissions.
For further information about the role, please contact Vincent Nguyen, Senior Manager Road Design at vincent.nguyen@transport.vic.gov.au (email decoded from the page's Cloudflare-obfuscated link).
Redeployees
If you are a VPS redeployee, please state this in your cover letter and include your case manager’s contact details. This helps ensure your redeployment status is appropriately considered. For more information on redeployment, visit the Victorian Government policy.
Important Information
If you require any adjustments to fully participate in the recruitment process or need the advert or attachments in an accessible format (e.g., large print), please contact us. We're here to support you.
Applications close Tuesday 6 October 2026 at 11.59pm
